Study area research (optional AI feature: needs an Anthropic API key)

What is already known about each study area, summarised from a repository of files and public data. Add files or links; the research agent reads each source once, keeps a digest, and writes the summary with every point cited. It can also look for new public data, which you approve before it is read.

Study

What the study is for, the cases it uses, and any study files you already have.

Not connected to the study desk. Folder browsing, one-click study creation, bus lists and runs need it. Double-click start_study_desk.bat in the repo folder, then open http://127.0.0.1:8770. Here, Create study saves a request file instead.
Example loaded: the AZ / ED-5 footprint. Replace it with your study's geography.

Projects from another case

Compare the study case with another case. TARA solves both (basecase only, once per case) and the differences in its case reports are grouped into projects. Flag whole projects or single elements to carry into the study case. Nothing changes until the study is created; the flags then go into the study for the change files.
